visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with short hair and bangs, wearing a brown t-shirt with a tomato illustration and beige shorts, sits at a light-colored wooden table. Beside her sits a calm orange and white tabby cat. She holds small, colorful plastic toy sea creatures. The background features a bright indoor living room with a white sofa and a toy kitchen set by a window. (2) The girl picks up a green plastic fishing rod and holds it toward the cat's face. The cat maintains a neutral expression and looks away. Bright, natural daylight illuminates the scene from a large window behind them. (3) She gathers the plastic toys into a small black bowl on the table, stands up, and walks across a gray and white puzzle play mat toward the toy kitchen set. The camera pans slightly to follow her movement. (4) Standing at the toy kitchen, she places the bowl on the play counter and interacts with the stove knobs. A small white toy fish falls onto the mat. She bends down to pick it up. (5) The girl holds a white cup filled with toys and dumps them into the black bowl. She then moves to a white storage bin and begins tossing toys onto the floor with both hands. (6) The video transitions to a solid pink graphic card featuring a central cartoon illustration of a young girl and centered white text at the bottom.

(2) The child's voice rises in pitch and excitement. Another percussive plastic 'clack' occurs as toys are gathered. The mother laughs heartily, her voice exhibiting high spectral brightness and dynamic range. (3) Continuous conversation between the female adult and the child maintains a high valence. Short, rhythmic thuds of plastic hitting plastic are heard as a bowl is filled. Footsteps shuffle softly on a padded floor. (4) An adult male voice joins the mix, characterized by a playful, narrative tone with moderate intensity. The piano BGM remains consistent in the background. The child responds with enunciated, clear phrases at a natural speech rate. (5) A single 'thud' sound effect occurs as a toy drops on a soft mat. This is followed by a loud, chaotic cascade of rapid plastic impacts as multiple objects are dumped out. Laughter from both adults overlaps with the percussive noise. (6) The piano music swells slightly in volume and then gradually fades out along with the lingering sound of laughter, ending in studio-clean silence.
